what: The brief gave Relax's warm run of hello-world as 37.8 MB resident and 23.9 MB footprint. That run had failed: `relax run --quiet hello` from the project's parent directory finds no manifest, exits 1 after 10 ms, and `/usr/bin/time -l` reports the failed process. The real warm run is 87 MB resident (footprint 50), a comment edit 117 (71), a body edit 127 (79), cold 250 (162).
cost: the target the strategy is held to was off by a factor of two to three until measured again
cause: an exit status and an output nobody checked (H2 says to)
workaround: every run's status and output are checked in this lane's relax_measure.py
state: fixed in this lane's numbers; the guard is H2 and memstrat-h3
